_help: Everything Ramanan says and plays. Audio names refer to files in assets/characters/ramanan/audio/ (.wav or .mp3);
leave out "audio" for a text-only line. The text below is a starting point: replace it with your own.
dialogues: he comes to you, shows the text (and plays its audio) and waits for OK. Optional "pose" and "action" (cheer, spin).
ok: the button label and the clip played on OK. mouse: click, dblclick, dragStart, drop, hover. goodbye: when he is switched off.

dialogues.text: Oru chaya kudichittu pani thudaram, alle?
Njan ivide thanne und, vilichal mathi.
